svg.title: Nivi and Livi: a little pixel playground
svg.desc: Nivi, a ginger cat, nudges a ball toward Livi, a sleepy apricot-orange cat with russet spots, who wakes and bats it back. Nivi takes a portal shortcut to catch it. Nivi asks, Play with me? Livi agrees, One round. After the portal shortcut, Livi asks, Portals? Really? Nivi replies, Work smarter. Livi says, Nap harder. Nivi later asks for a rematch. All poses share a consistent head scale and ground line.
